Title: Self-hosted/offline-first is a non-negotiable product constraint
Decision: The system must run in restricted networks with no runtime SaaS dependency for Project A. Development may use internet, runtime must not require it.

Title: Split product into Remote Cockpit, Agentic Desktop, and Agentic Work Board
Decision: Separation reduces MVP scope and lets each product create standalone value while sharing protocols.

Title: Treat board/ticket as the control plane for agent work
Decision: Agent chat is not the system of record; tickets own runs, approvals, evidence and review state.

Title: Use existing remote desktop tools before building custom WebRTC host agent
Support both VPN-first and DMZ-first Topology C deployment
Decision: Company VPN and DMZ gateway are the practical ways to create the missing network path.

Title: Use QR for short-lived pairing, not credential transfer
Decision: QR payload contains pairing ID, gateway, nonce and public keys; credentials stay in OS/keychain/server.

Title: Use model gateway abstraction for AI providers
Decision: Support BYOK frontier models, internal LiteLLM/vLLM/Ollama endpoints and local fallback without locking to one vendor.

Title: Approval-first AI tool execution
Decision: File writes, shell commands, browser/app control and network/secrets actions are policy-gated and audited.

Title: Knowledge base and code forge are future platform modules
Decision: Confluence/Jira/GitHub-inspired future is valid but should not enter MVP scope as full clones.

Title: Integrate existing Git forges before building native forge
Decision: Gitea/Forgejo/GitLab/GitHub Enterprise integrations are safer than cloning GitHub/GitLab early.

Title: Use private reviewed skill registry
Decision: No unreviewed community skills in production; skills declare permissions and approval needs.

Title: Every important action is an event
Decision: Sessions, ticket transitions, approvals, tool calls, artifacts and admin actions emit audit events.

Title: Offline release bundle is part of product quality gate
Decision: No release is accepted until installed in an isolated test network.

Title: Postpone full autonomous GUI computer-use
Decision: Start with files/terminal/git/browser automation; full GUI computer-use arrives after safety scaffolding.

Title: Use adapters for agent runtimes
Decision: opencode, goose, Cline, Kilo, OpenHands-like systems are behind adapters rather than hard dependencies.

Title: MVP board is agent-native, not full Jira clone
Decision: Build only tickets, states, acceptance criteria, agent runs, approvals and evidence first.

Title: Docs/knowledge base must serve humans and agents
Decision: Product docs, ADRs, runbooks and research notes become context packs for agent work.

Title: Security is product surface, not backend-only concern
Decision: UX must show modes, policy, approval, audit, watermarking and kill-switch controls.
